（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 16
Date 17/1/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

January 17th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that the local rebels have for the present abandoned the idea of starting a rising here.
It is reported that the Nanking officials have agreed to join the rebels as soon as the latter furnish money, with which to pay the troops. It is said that this money has been collected among the emigrants and was expected to arrive yesterday. It is not known whether it came or not. However the rebels feel confident of being able to raise the necessary funds in the new future.
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels have sent one of their number named Zee Ping Liang 徐秉良 to Nanking to confer with General Feng Kuo Chang 馮國璋 about the situation in Yunnan. The rebels are experiencing great difficulty in getting authentic news from that place. Zee is said to be an intimate friend of Sun Yat Sen.
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels have sent another man named Zau Ching Tsu 曹敬祖 to Hangchow to organise the rebels there and be ready to rise as soon as Nanking declares independence.
It is reported that Yuan Shih Kai has sent a General named Liu 劉 to Shanghai to consult with General Yang and ascertain the real attitude of the soldiers here. Liu is said to have arrived two days ago and is now staying at No.101 Nyung Kong Li 甯康里 outside the West Gate.
The Arsenal yesterday supplied General Lu 盧 with four thousand new suits of uniform for the Woosung garrison.
With reference to the report that the Shanghai Taoyin had ordered the newspapers to change to the new calendar it is now reported that anonymous letters have been received by the various editors that any one who complies with the order will be given "Health pills" 衛生丸.
It is reported that the head office of the revolutionaries in Shanghai is situated at No.50 Pao Kang Li 寶康里 Avenue Joffre. The house in question is said to be rented by a man named Sung Ong Yien 宋昂仁 who belongs to the Progressive party.
It is reported that Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 who is said to be living in the French Concession has received a cablegram from Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙 requesting him to go to Japan at once.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探科））
刑事侦缉处
情报登记
第16号
日期 26年1月17日

致上海公共租界工部局。

1916年1月17日

先生：
据报，本地反叛者目前已放弃在此发动起义的计划。
据报，南京官员已同意一旦反叛者提供资金以支付军饷，便加入反叛者行列。据悉，这笔资金是在流亡者中筹集的，预计昨日抵达。目前尚不知其是否已到。然而，反叛者对在不远的将来筹集到必要资金充满信心。
据报，上海反叛者已派遣一名名为徐秉良（Zee Ping Liang）的成员前往南京，与冯国璋将军商讨云南局势。反叛者在获取该地真实消息方面正经历极大困难。据说徐是孙中山的密友。
据报，上海反叛者已派遣另一名名为曹敬祖（Zau Ching Tsu）的人前往杭州，组织那里的反叛者，并准备一旦南京宣布独立即行起事。
据报，袁世凯已派遣一名刘姓将军前往上海，与杨将军商议，并查明此地士兵的真实态度。据说刘于两天前抵达，现住在西门外甯康里101号。
兵工厂昨日向卢将军提供了四千套新制服，供吴淞驻军使用。
关于上海道台下令报纸改用新历的报道，现据报各编辑收到匿名信，称任何服从该命令的人将被给予“卫生丸”。
据报，革命党人在上海的总部设在霞飞路宝康里50号。据说该房屋由一名属于进步党的名为宋昂仁（Sung Ong Yien）的人租用。
据报，据说居住在法租界的陈其美收到孙中山发来的电报，要求他立即前往日本。
据报，一名名为单耀明（Dan Yao Ming）的反叛领袖昨日离开上海前往广州，他将在那里

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

(2)                                                                                             191

take command of a regiment of the anti-monarchical army.
San 言等 is said to be a sworn brother of Admiral Zau
Kya Ziang 曹嘉祥 who came here by order of Yuan Shih
Kai to investigate the Chacho incident.
    The seven robbers, arrested at Zao Oo Kyung 曹家屋
village Lungwha, have had two trials at the Arsenal.
One of them who is a Christian and who is said not to be
concerned with the others was released at the second
hearing at the instance of a foreign missionary.
    Thirty five members of the City gentry held a private
meeting in the City yesterday when it was decided to
oppose strongly the laying of tram rails within the City.
    It is rumoured in the teashops that the Chinese
bankers in the vicinity of Ningpo Road are not satisfied
with the services rendered by the Police watchmen, whom
they employ at present at a cost of about $4,000.00 per
month. It is said that the bankers are now negotiating
with a view to entrusting their protection to a military
detective named Zoe Ching Sun 徐金生 who is willing to
undertake the work for $240.00 per month.

                                                Your Obedient Servant,

                                                (签名)

                                                Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
致上海公共租界工部局。

（印：上海公共租界工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

(2)                                                                                             191

指挥一支反君主制军队的一个团。
据说单（San）是海军上将曹嘉祥（Zau Kya Ziang）的结拜兄弟，曹是奉袁世凯之命前来调查查超（Chacho）事件的。
在龙华曹家屋村逮捕的七名强盗已在兵工厂受审两次。其中一人是基督徒，据说与其他人无关，在一位外国传教士的请求下，于第二次听审时被释放。
昨日，三十五名城内绅商在城内举行了一次私人会议，决定强烈反对在城内铺设电车轨道。
茶馆里流传着谣言，称宁波路附近的中国银行家对目前以每月约4,000.00美元的费用雇用的警察巡夜人员的服务不满意。据说银行家们正在进行谈判，打算将保护工作委托给一名名为徐金生（Zoe Ching Sun）的军事侦探，此人愿意以每月240.00美元的报酬承担此项工作。

                                                您顺从的仆人，

                                                (签名)

                                                总探长。

警务处总监。
